Clear.Label: clear
Clear.Description: A clear day. No penalties or modifiers.

Fog.Label: fog
Fog.Description: Fog reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons.

Rain.Label: rain
Rain.Description: Rain reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons, extinguishes fire, and slows people down.

DryThunderstorm.Label: dry thunderstorm
DryThunderstorm.Description: Dry thunderstorms are dangerous because the lightning can start fires and there is no rain to put them out.

RainyThunderstorm.Label: rainy thunderstorm
RainyThunderstorm.Description: The lightning will start fires, but the rain will put it out. The rain also reduces movement speed and shooting accuracy.

SnowHard.Label: hard snow
SnowHard.Description: Snow reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons, extinguishes fire, and slows people down.

SnowGentle.Label: gentle snow
SnowGentle.Description: Snow reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons, extinguishes fire, and slows people down.

BloodRain.Label: blood rain
BloodRain.Description:
Anyone exposed to the blood rain for long enough will be driven into a berserk rage. Certain traits and psychic sensitivity influence the berserk effect.
(Anomaly)

ToxRain.Label: tox rain
ToxRain.Description:
Tox rain makes creatures sick with toxic buildup. It also reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons, extinguishes fire, and slows people down.
(Odyssey)

Sandstorm.Label: sandstorm
Sandstorm.Description:
Sandstorms reduce the accuracy of ranged weapons, slow people down, and get sand everywhere.
(Odyssey)

BlindFog.Label: blind fog
BlindFog.Description:
A heavy fog that reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons, as well as their maximum range.
(Odyssey)

Overcast.Label: overcast
Overcast.Description:
Thick clouds obscure the sky, reducing light levels.
(Odyssey)

Blizzard.Label: blizzard
Blizzard.Description:
Snow reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons, extinguishes fire, and slows people down.
(Odyssey)

TorrentialRain.Label: torrential rain
TorrentialRain.Description:
Torrential rain causes flooding. It also reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons, extinguishes fire, and slows people down.
(Odyssey)

VPE_Hurricane.Label: hurricane
VPE_Hurricane.Description:
Extreme wind will cause a slowdown to everyone not under the roof.
(Vanilla Psycasts Expanded)

VPE_RadioactiveFog.Label: radioactive fog
VPE_RadioactiveFog.Description:
A Nuclear reactor's meltdown has freed a cloud of radioactive material. This fog will hinder ranged attacks until it dissipates.
(Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Power)

Sinnamon_Windy.Label: whirlwind
Sinnamon_Windy.Description:
Wind is increasing the wind turbine output.
(More Ritual Rewards)

VPEH_Bloodstorm.Label: bloodstorm
VPEH_Bloodstorm.Description:
Mystical downpour of blood, caused by forbidden hemosage psycast. While non-hemogenic individuals are choking on blood, sanguophages regenerate hemogen and can cast psycasts without worrying about psychic heat.
(Vanilla Psycasts Expanded - Hemosage)

VEE_FertileRains.Label: fertile rain
VEE_FertileRains.Description:
Unusually nutrient-rich rainfall is sweeping across the region, boosting plant growth for its duration.
(Vanilla Landmarks Expanded)

VEE_DustStorm.Label: dust storm
VEE_DustStorm.Description:
A choking wall of wind-driven dust sweeps across the land, reducing visibility, slowing movement, and scouring anything left exposed.
(Vanilla Landmarks Expanded)

VPE_NoctisApocalypsisSTNL.Label: Night Of The Apocalypse
VPE_NoctisApocalypsisSTNL.Description:
There is no natural light in the world.
(VPE - Luminis)

VPE_EternalNightSTNL.Label: Eternal Night
VPE_EternalNightSTNL.Description:
There is no natural light in the world.
(VPE - Luminis)

UmbraDarknessSTNL.Label: Localized darkness
UmbraDarknessSTNL.Description:
Light is being blocked by a psychic phenomenon.
(VPE - Umbra)

VPE_Veincaster_BloodStorm_STNL.Label: Blood Stream
VPE_Veincaster_BloodStorm_STNL.Description:
A Veincaster has caused a mysterious stream of blood to pour down onto the area.
(VPE - Veincaster)

AB_RedFog.Label: red fog
AB_RedFog.Description:
Red fog reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons.
(Alpha Biomes)

AB_VolcanicAsh.Label: volcanic ash
AB_VolcanicAsh.Description:
A mixture of rock, mineral, and glass particles expelled from a volcano during a volcanic eruption. This creates a thick atmospheric layer that reduces ranged accuracy.
(Alpha Biomes)

AB_VolcanicAshRain.Label: volcanic ash with rain
AB_VolcanicAshRain.Description:
A mixture of rock, mineral, and glass particles expelled from a volcano during a volcanic eruption, precipitating with rain. This creates a thick atmospheric layer that reduces ranged accuracy.
(Alpha Biomes)

AB_ForsakenNight.Label: forsaken fog
AB_ForsakenNight.Description:
A preternatural darkness that seeps into your very soul. Even during the "day" brightness will be very low, so lighting is going to be absolutely essential. Nights are going to be REALLY dark.
(Alpha Biomes)

AB_ForsakenRainyNight.Label: forsaken rain
AB_ForsakenRainyNight.Description:
A preternatural darkness that seeps into your very soul. A freezing rain of supercooled water has started to drop from the darkened sky.
(Alpha Biomes)

AB_ForsakenThunderstorm.Label: forsaken thunderstorm
AB_ForsakenThunderstorm.Description:
A preternatural darkness that seeps into your very soul. Now with a dry thunderstorm! Isn't it great?
(Alpha Biomes)

AB_AcidRainWeather.Label: acid rain
AB_AcidRainWeather.Description:
Toxic gas emissions from nearby volcanically active calderas are precipitating in the form of dangerous acid rain. Acid rain has an adverse impact on flora and fauna, killing insect and aquatic life-forms as well as having impacts on human health. Acid rain reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons, extinguishes fire, and slows people down.
(Alpha Biomes)

AB_PetalStorms.Label: petal storm
AB_PetalStorms.Description:
A flurry of flower petals that improves mood but reduces visibility.
(Alpha Biomes)

AB_ForsakenNight_Alternate.Label: forsaken fog
AB_ForsakenNight_Alternate.Description:
A preternatural darkness that seeps into your very soul. Even during the "day" brightness will be very low, so lighting is going to be absolutely essential. Nights are going to be REALLY dark.
(Alpha Biomes)

AB_ForsakenRainyNight_Alternate.Label: forsaken rain
AB_ForsakenRainyNight_Alternate.Description:
A preternatural darkness that seeps into your very soul. A freezing rain of supercooled water has started to drop from the darkened sky.
(Alpha Biomes)

AB_ForsakenThunderstorm_Alternate.Label: forsaken thunderstorm
AB_ForsakenThunderstorm_Alternate.Description:
A preternatural darkness that seeps into your very soul. Now with a dry thunderstorm! Isn't it great?
(Alpha Biomes)

VEE_Whiteout.Label: whiteout
VEE_Whiteout.Description:
Heavy, chilling snow that severely reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons, extinguishes fire and slows people down.
(Vanilla Events Expanded)

VEE_Swelter.Label: swelter
VEE_Swelter.Description:
An unnatural, oppressive heat.
(Vanilla Events Expanded)

VEE_Inferno.Label: inferno
VEE_Inferno.Description:
A catastrophic, unnatural, oppressive heat.
(Vanilla Events Expanded)

VEE_PsychicRain.Label: psychic rain
VEE_PsychicRain.Description:
A seemingly supernatural rain that alters the very composition of time. Any person or creature not under a roof will age significantly faster.
(Vanilla Events Expanded)

VEE_LongNight.Label: long night
VEE_LongNight.Description:
A catastrophic celestial eclipse that blankets the world in an endless, freezing twilight, forcing the world to adapt to artificial light and increased psychic sensitivity as nocturnal predators and subterranean threats emerge in the darkness.
(Vanilla Events Expanded)

IsekaiThickMist.Label: whale-mist
IsekaiThickMist.Description:
An unnatural, soupy mist conjured by the Whale of the Mist. It clings to everything and swallows sight at a few paces. Ranged fire is nearly useless inside it.
(ISEKAI CREATURES ADD-ON - Isekai RPG Leveling)
